4 /-! A short cut ray permits an outer apex cone wider than the angle between the two cut rays. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
7 
8 open Real

10 /-- The half-sum angle bound is exactly the sine comparison needed by the wider separator. -/
11 theorem wider_cone_sine_comparison (θ lam : ℝ) (θ_pos : 0 < θ) (beyond : θ < lam)
12     (bounded : lam ≤ (π + θ) / 2) : sin (lam - θ) ≤ sin lam := by
13   have identity := sin_sub_sin lam (lam - θ)
14   have half_pos : 0 ≤ (lam - (lam - θ)) / 2 := by linarith
15   have half_small : (lam - (lam - θ)) / 2 ≤ π := by linarith [pi_pos]
16   have cosine_nonnegative : 0 ≤ cos ((lam + (lam - θ)) / 2) :=
17     cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], by linarith⟩
18   have sine_nonnegative := sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi half_pos half_small
19   nlinarith [mul_nonneg sine_nonnegative cosine_nonnegative]
20 
21 /-- With a short left cut side, its outer angle may be as large as half of pi plus the central angle. -/
22 theorem wider_apex_cones_left (p q : Plane) (δ θ lam rho A B : ℝ)
23     (θ_pos : 0 < θ) (θ_small : θ < π)
24     (lam_pos : 0 < lam) (lam_small : lam < π) (rho_pos : 0 < rho) (rho_small : rho < π)
25     (angle_sum : lam + rho < π + θ) (wide_bound : lam ≤ (π + θ) / 2)
26     (left_short : A ≤ 0) (strict_sum : A + B < 0)
27     (displacement : q - p = A • direction (δ + θ) + B • direction δ) :
28     Disjoint (interior (translatedCone p (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ))))
29       (interior (translatedCone q (-direction δ) (-direction (δ + rho)))) := by
30   by_cases within : lam ≤ θ
31   · apply opposed_cones_interiors_disjoint_of_height p q _ _ _ _ (detHeight (direction δ))
32       (direction_height_surjective δ)
33     · change det (direction δ) (q - p) ≤ 0
34       rw [displacement, det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_smul_right, direction_det, direction_det,
35         show δ + θ - δ = θ by ring, sub_self, sin_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
36       exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg left_short (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi θ_pos θ_small).le
37     · change 0 ≤ det (direction δ) (direction (δ + θ - lam))
38       rw [direction_det]
39       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
40     · change 0 ≤ det (direction δ) (direction (δ + θ))
41       rw [direction_det]
42       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
43     · change 0 ≤ det (direction δ) (direction δ)
44       rw [det_self]
45     · change 0 ≤ det (direction δ) (direction (δ + rho))
46       rw [direction_det]
47       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
48   · have beyond : θ < lam := lt_of_not_ge within
49     let g := direction (δ + θ - lam)
50     have difference_pos : 0 < sin (lam - θ) :=
51       sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
52     have sine_order := wider_cone_sine_comparison θ lam θ_pos beyond wide_bound
53     have negative_height : det g (q - p) < 0 := by
54       rw [displacement, det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_smul_right]
55       change A * det (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ)) +
56         B * det (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction δ) < 0
57       rw [direction_det, direction_det, show δ + θ - (δ + θ - lam) = lam by ring,
58         show δ - (δ + θ - lam) = lam - θ by ring]
59       have first := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg left_short (sub_nonneg.mpr sine_order)
60       have second := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos strict_sum difference_pos
61       nlinarith
62     have ray_nonnegative (x : ℝ) (lo : δ + θ - lam ≤ x) (hi : x ≤ δ + θ - lam + π) :
63         0 ≤ det g (direction x) := by
64       change 0 ≤ det (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction x)
65       rw [direction_det]
66       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
67     have separated := opposed_cones_disjoint_of_height p q
68       (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ)) (direction δ) (direction (δ + rho))
69       (detHeight g).toLinearMap negative_height
70       (ray_nonnegative (δ + θ - lam) le_rfl (by linarith [pi_pos]))
71       (ray_nonnegative (δ + θ) (by linarith) (by linarith))
72       (ray_nonnegative δ (by linarith) (by linarith))
73       (ray_nonnegative (δ + rho) (by linarith) (by linarith))
74     exact separated.mono interior_subset interior_subset

76 /-- The symmetric short-right-side criterion uses the other outer angle. -/
77 theorem wider_apex_cones_right (p q : Plane) (δ θ lam rho A B : ℝ)
78     (θ_pos : 0 < θ) (θ_small : θ < π)
79     (lam_pos : 0 < lam) (lam_small : lam < π) (rho_pos : 0 < rho) (rho_small : rho < π)
80     (angle_sum : lam + rho < π + θ) (wide_bound : rho ≤ (π + θ) / 2)
81     (right_short : B ≤ 0) (strict_sum : A + B < 0)
82     (displacement : q - p = A • direction (δ + θ) + B • direction δ) :
83     Disjoint (interior (translatedCone p (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ))))
84       (interior (translatedCone q (-direction δ) (-direction (δ + rho)))) := by
85   have onto (γ : ℝ) : Function.Surjective (-detHeight (direction γ)) := by
86     intro r
87     obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := direction_height_surjective γ (-r)
88     refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
89     change -detHeight (direction γ) x = r
90     rw [hx]
91     ring
92   by_cases within : rho ≤ θ
93   · apply opposed_cones_interiors_disjoint_of_height p q _ _ _ _ (-detHeight (direction (δ + θ))) (onto _)
94     · change -det (direction (δ + θ)) (q - p) ≤ 0
95       rw [displacement, det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_smul_right, det_self, mul_zero, zero_add,
96         direction_det, show δ - (δ + θ) = -θ by ring, sin_neg]
97       have signed := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg right_short (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi θ_pos θ_small).le
98       nlinarith
99     · change 0 ≤ -det (direction (δ + θ)) (direction (δ + θ - lam))
100       rw [det_swap, neg_neg, direction_det]
101       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
102     · change 0 ≤ -det (direction (δ + θ)) (direction (δ + θ))
103       rw [det_self, neg_zero]
104     · change 0 ≤ -det (direction (δ + θ)) (direction δ)
105       rw [det_swap, neg_neg, direction_det]
106       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
107     · change 0 ≤ -det (direction (δ + θ)) (direction (δ + rho))
108       rw [det_swap, neg_neg, direction_det]
109       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
110   · have beyond : θ < rho := lt_of_not_ge within
111     let g := direction (δ + rho)
112     have difference_pos : 0 < sin (rho - θ) :=
113       sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
114     have sine_order := wider_cone_sine_comparison θ rho θ_pos beyond wide_bound
115     have negative_height : -det g (q - p) < 0 := by
116       rw [displacement, det_add_right, det_smul_right, det_smul_right]
117       change -(A * det (direction (δ + rho)) (direction (δ + θ)) +
118         B * det (direction (δ + rho)) (direction δ)) < 0
119       rw [direction_det, direction_det, show δ + θ - (δ + rho) = -(rho - θ) by ring,
120         show δ - (δ + rho) = -rho by ring, sin_neg, sin_neg]
121       have first := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg right_short (sub_nonneg.mpr sine_order)
122       have second := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos strict_sum difference_pos
123       nlinarith
124     have ray_nonnegative (x : ℝ) (lo : δ + rho - π ≤ x) (hi : x ≤ δ + rho) :
125         0 ≤ -det g (direction x) := by
126       change 0 ≤ -det (direction (δ + rho)) (direction x)
127       rw [det_swap, neg_neg, direction_det]
128       apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
129     have separated := opposed_cones_disjoint_of_height p q
130       (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ)) (direction δ) (direction (δ + rho))
131       (-detHeight g).toLinearMap negative_height
132       (ray_nonnegative (δ + θ - lam) (by linarith) (by linarith))
133       (ray_nonnegative (δ + θ) (by linarith) (by linarith))
134       (ray_nonnegative δ (by linarith) (by linarith))
135       (ray_nonnegative (δ + rho) (by linarith [pi_pos]) le_rfl)
136     exact separated.mono interior_subset interior_subset

138 /-- If both outer angles satisfy the wider bound, the strict distance sum guarantees a short side. -/
139 theorem wider_apex_cones (p q : Plane) (δ θ lam rho A B : ℝ)
140     (θ_pos : 0 < θ) (θ_small : θ < π)
141     (lam_pos : 0 < lam) (lam_small : lam < π) (rho_pos : 0 < rho) (rho_small : rho < π)
142     (angle_sum : lam + rho < π + θ)
143     (left_bound : lam ≤ (π + θ) / 2) (right_bound : rho ≤ (π + θ) / 2)
144     (strict_sum : A + B < 0)
145     (displacement : q - p = A • direction (δ + θ) + B • direction δ) :
146     Disjoint (interior (translatedCone p (direction (δ + θ - lam)) (direction (δ + θ))))
147       (interior (translatedCone q (-direction δ) (-direction (δ + rho)))) := by
148   by_cases left_short : A ≤ 0
149   · exact wider_apex_cones_left p q δ θ lam rho A B θ_pos θ_small lam_pos lam_small rho_pos rho_small
150       angle_sum left_bound left_short strict_sum displacement
151   · exact wider_apex_cones_right p q δ θ lam rho A B θ_pos θ_small lam_pos lam_small rho_pos rho_small
152       angle_sum right_bound (by linarith) strict_sum displacement
153 
154 end SixVertexUnfolding
